ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use Alexa at home, but I have no current need for an in-car Alexa device.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would try this to control a lamp through my existing Echo devices.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Seagate Expansion 16TB External Hard Drive HDD - USB 3.0, with Rescue Data Recovery Services (STKP16000402); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to expand backup storage beyond my older 4TB drive; the recovery service also interests me.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Certified Refurbished Blink Outdoor - wireless, weather-resistant HD security camera, two-year battery life, motion detection, set up in minutes – 2 camera kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Cameras could extend my basic home security setup, but I would first decide where I need outdoor coverage.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Flex - Plug-in mini smart speaker with Alexa; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing Echo devices already provide Alexa access, so this adds little right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought an Echo Show 5 and its stand, so I am not looking for another display.
